description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named SecurityController that manages user profile views and updates, including profile editing and patching functionalities, with security annotations ensuring only authenticated users with the role 'ROLE_USER' can access these endpoints.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller handling user profile viewing and editing, secured with role 'ROLE_USER'. It provides endpoints for viewing the current user's profile, editing user details, and patching user details, utilizing repositories and services for data access and modification.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/profile'; retrieves the current authenticated user's profile and list of enrollments, and adds them to the model for rendering.

methods.name: getForEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/user/edit/{userID}'; retrieves user information for editing if the current user is authorized.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/user/edit/{userID}'; updates the user's profile information after authorization check.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/user/patch/{id_user}'; updates specific user details (patch) after authorization check.
